games.title: Neon Horizon
games.description: A fast-paced cyberpunk platformer set in a dystopian megacity. Dodge laser grids, hack security systems, and outrun corporate enforcers across 40 handcrafted levels. Featuring a synthwave soundtrack and fluid wall-running mechanics that reward mastery.

games.title: Verdant Abyss
games.description: Descend into a bioluminescent underground world teeming with alien flora and ancient mysteries. Craft tools from rare minerals, cultivate symbiotic plants, and unravel the story of a civilization that fled underground centuries ago.

games.title: Hollow Epoch
games.description: A haunting action-RPG set in a world where time has shattered into overlapping eras. Shift between past and future versions of every location, manipulating history to forge a new present. Features 60+ hours of non-linear storytelling.

games.title: Saltpeak
games.description: A serene puzzle game set atop stormy Nordic peaks. Guide wind currents to carry seeds across treacherous cliffs, regrowing a shattered mountain ecosystem. 80 meditative levels with no timers, no enemies — just you and the elements.

games.title: Iron Caravan
games.description: Command a mercenary trading convoy across a fractured continent. Negotiate with warlords, manage crew morale, and make split-second decisions when bandits ambush your route. Every playthrough generates a new political map.

games.title: Deeproot
games.description: Survive the collapse of a forest ecosystem by playing as a network of underground mycelium. Spread your fungal network, trade nutrients with trees, and defend against invasive species in this unique survival-strategy hybrid.

games.title: Phase Shift
games.description: A rhythm game where the entire world is your instrument. Every surface, enemy, and platform produces sound — build up a live musical composition as you traverse each stage. Features 30 original tracks from indie electronic artists.
